## tinymist-flow

**A personal Typst preview workspace for macOS.**

tinymist-flow manages Typst projects from the menu bar: project settings, preview services, login startup, logs, and recoverable app updates.

This repository contains the native app, packaging, branding, app tests, and documentation. A compatible external tinymist executable supplies document compilation and preview rendering and is copied into each app bundle as `flow-engine`.

[Issues](https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow/issues) · [User guide source](docs/tinymist/flow-app.typ) · [Development guide](docs/dev-guide.md)

## Build and test

Use macOS 13 or newer with the Swift compiler and Python 3. If Flow is already installed at `~/Applications/tinymist-flow.app`, its engine supplies the default build:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow.git
cd tinymist-flow
python3 scripts/flow-app.py build
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/flow-app -v
```

For another engine location, pass `--engine /absolute/path/to/flow-engine` or set `FLOW_ENGINE_PATH`. Use a compatible Flow engine with the existing preview features, including `--follow-system-theme`, assistant focus records, and change restoration. Packaging checks the preview CLI before replacing an output bundle.

For a release, pass `--version` with the intended release number and build from a clean commit. The manifest records the Flow source revision, external engine version, input hash, bundled engine hash, and signing mode.

## Install and use

```sh
python3 scripts/flow-app.py install dist/tinymist-flow.app
```

Open `~/Applications/tinymist-flow.app`, add a Typst entry file, and start its preview. Tail Hosting manages optional Tailscale HTTPS routes. The bundled [user guide](docs/tinymist/flow-app.typ) covers mobile reading, device themes, source selection, updates, and rollback.

```sh
python3 scripts/flow-app.py verify ~/Applications/tinymist-flow.app
python3 scripts/flow-app.py rollback
```

## Repository

- `apps/macos/`: native app and Tail Hosting adapter.
- `scripts/flow-app.py`: build, installation, recovery, and migration.
- `tests/flow-app/`: freshly compiled app configuration tests and packaging recovery checks.
- `assets/branding/`: app icon and branding source.
- `docs/tinymist/`: canonical Typst user and developer documentation.
- `openspec/`: Flow app behavior and workflow contracts.

The engine is an external dependency. Previous engine and editor sources remain available in Git history. The earlier independent repository remains [tinymist-flow-archive](https://github.com/kimpossible-TY/tinymist-flow-archive).

README is generated from `docs/tinymist/tinymist-flow.typ`. Use an external `typlite` executable and run `node scripts/link-docs.mjs`; see the development guide for details.
